    Mohamed El Mehdi Makhlouf

    AI/ML & Data R&D Engineer · PhD Candidate Self-supervised learning, scientific data and reproducible machine-learning systems.

    Explore my work Download CV mehdi.makhlouf.pro@gmail.com

    I work across the complete applied-research cycle: scientific framing, data modelling, algorithm design, comparative experimentation, software delivery and communication. My experience spans telecommunications, energy and healthcare.

    Research · Engineering · Collaboration

    From scientific questions to usable, documented results

    I am completing a PhD in computer science at Inria Lyon and INSA Lyon, where I develop self-supervised representations of radio measurements for channel charting, localisation, prediction and RIS control. I also bring applied R&D experience from TotalEnergies, ResilEyes Therapeutics and the Marc Jeannerod Institute of Cognitive Science.

    My work combines machine learning, signal processing, statistical modelling, reproducible experimentation and technical communication with scientific and industrial partners.
